entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE indicates support and preference for CIoT EPS optimizations.

entities.name: Tracking area updating procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE indicates support and preference for CIoT EPS optimizations.

entities.name: CIoT EPS optimization support indication
entities.description: IE indicating UE support for control plane CIoT EPS optimization, user plane CIoT EPS optimization, EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection, S1-U data transfer, and header compression.

entities.name: CIoT EPS optimization preference indication
entities.description: IE indicating UE preference for control plane or user plane CIoT EPS optimization, considered as a request to use.

entities.name: Control plane CIoT EPS optimization
entities.description: Enables efficient transport of user data or SMS over control plane via MME without triggering data radio bearer establishment.

entities.name: User plane CIoT EPS optimization
entities.description: Enables change from EMM-IDLE to EMM-CONNECTED mode without service request procedure.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection
entities.description: UE remains EPS attached even after releasing all PDN connections.

entities.name: S1-U data transfer
entities.description: Support for S1-U data transfer, required if UE supports user plane CIoT EPS optimization.

entities.name: NB-S1 mode
entities.description: UE mode where control plane CIoT EPS optimization is always indicated and certain restrictions apply.

entities.name: WB-S1 mode
entities.description: UE mode where CIoT EPS optimizations can be optionally indicated.

entities.name: MT-EDT support indication
entities.description: Condition where UE indicates support for control plane or user plane MT-EDT during attach or TAU.
